description: Japan Environmental Statistics municipal waste series is published by Ministry of the Environment Japan. The statistical collection covers waste quantities, treatment flows and waste-management facilities. Its stated coverage is Japan; national trends and prefectural tables. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider page describes access through its website or linked resources; the underlying files or applications were not downloaded or run. The inspected public resource is free to access. The inspected page does not state a reusable licence. Different tables have different reference years; the listed spreadsheets were not downloaded. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
